definition: Activities that categorise data by sensitivity, criticality, legal status or business value and apply handling requirements to each category. Includes data classification frameworks, sensitivity or criticality tiers, information asset inventories linked to classification, labelling, access, encryption, retention, sharing, hosting, transfer and disposal rules based on class, implementation tools, staff training and compliance monitoring. Excludes general data inventories without classification, statistical classifications and sector taxonomies unrelated to sensitivity or handling, document filing, cybersecurity awareness that does not define or apply data categories, and classification of physical assets.
